name: Plate-frame welded heat exchanger
full_description: Plate-frame heat exchanger is a patented product of Juyuan Hanyang Company and belongs to the welded plate heat exchanger category. According to the official product page, it integrates advanced international heat transfer technology, supports compact installation, and can implement API 662 and ASME standards according to user requirements.
advantage: High heat transfer coefficient and low resistance loss.
Strong adaptability to working conditions with flexible process combinations.
Better cleanability than brazed plate heat exchangers.
Strong temperature and pressure resistance for special media.

technical_parameters.Plate Material: TP304, TP316L, TP304L, TP317L, 254SMO, Titanium, N6, S31803 (SAF2205), 904L

seo_data.meta_description: Patented plate-frame welded heat exchanger with compact structure, high heat transfer efficiency, and strong cleanability.
